title: Mexican Enchilada Noodles
description: A spicy and flavorful noodle dish inspired by Mexican cuisine. This recipe is perfect for a quick and satisfying meal.
instructions: Cook the noodles according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the enchilada sauce over medium heat.
Add the energizing spice blend and stir well.
Add the black beans, diced tomatoes, chopped onion, and chopped garlic to the skillet.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the onion is translucent.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and stir well.
Transfer the noodle mixture to a serving dish.
Sprinkle the shredded cheese on top.
